text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Friday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The Mozambican and South African governments signed a memorandum of understanding in Maputo for the construction of a new dam on the Zambezi river. The two governments signed a separate memorandum for the building of an aluminium plant on the outskirts of the capital which will use some of the energy generated by the new dam.

- A government bill aimed at setting up decentralised municipal authorities in 22 Mozambican cities has passed its first reading in parliament with noisy protests from the main opposition Renamo party.
